cases.label: 轻微梦幻＋松散
cases.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Image 1 is the original synthetic photograph and the only source of subjects and scene composition. Image 2 is Mulgil Kim's Green Wave, used only for painting style and color/shape relationships. Do not copy the reference's surfer, surfboard, flower garland, or wave composition.
Repaint Image 1 as an original coherent gouache painting in the style of Mulgil Kim (김물길).
Fixed parameters for a controlled test: moderate scene reconstruction limited to the background green hills; layered green-blue palette; original daylight; matte gouache surface without heavy impasto; original horizontal 3:2 aspect ratio.
Must preserve: exactly one adult woman seen from behind, slightly left of center, shoulder-length dark hair, mustard sweater, cream trousers, small red backpack, original standing pose; large tree trunk at right with canopy above; pale curved path in foreground; blue lake between the woman and the distant green hills; two small white clouds. Repaint the woman as well, not as a photographic cutout.
Transfer from Image 2: calm flat turquoise-blue sky, unified luminous green masses with flowing organic contours, deliberate directional plant texture, quiet warmth and intimate human/environment relationship. User-selected brushwork below overrides the reference's dense fine grass texture.
Dreamlike level and brushwork are separate controls: do not change either because of the other.
No additional people, animals, objects, lettering, signature, watermark, photographic finish, glossy 3D, generic noisy impressionist color dabs. Keep the scene recognizable.

Dreamlike intensity: LOW / subtle. Keep the existing background hills natural in scale and geometry, with only slightly rhythmic contours that echo the calm lake. No giant curling hills, no floating forms, no dramatic surreal folding.

Brushwork/detail: LOOSE. Use broad, intentional matte gouache strokes and simplified color shapes for ALL areas, particularly tree leaves, tree bark, foreground ground and distant greenery. Group foliage into clear painted masses; do not paint individual fine blades of grass or tiny leaves. Keep crisp readable major shapes without blurring. Simplify clothing and backpack details while retaining their recognizable colors and silhouette. Background sky is a calm almost flat color field. Avoid meticulous botanical textures and photographic microdetail.
